children: The setup for future nuclear growth is the best it has been in a very long time, says UxC President Jonathan Hinze. He cites energy security concerns, policies to combat climate change and the rapid expansion of power needs, particularly for data centers. "At the same time, the nuclear fuel supply chain is not yet fully engaged in responding to this rising demand outlook despite significant increases in prices," he says. Hinze says there is potential for a shortfall by the 2030s, "with increasing needs for large amounts of new uranium mine development over the coming decade and beyond."
